name: mandalas
description: Generador procedural de mandalas para colorear.

scripts.sync: npm run www && npx cap copy && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run www && npx cap copy android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npm run www && npx cap copy android && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File dev/compilar-aab.ps1
